summary: Comprehensive test of bulk affiliate CSV invite generator: backend endpoint POST /api/admin/affiliates/bulk-invite (8/8 executed tests PASS, 1 skipped due to env constraint) and frontend BulkInviteModal flow on AdminAffiliates page (login → age gate bypass → admin panel → Import CSV → upload CSV with duplicates → submit → verify KPIs and generated codes). Full flow works end-to-end. One minor UI label typo found and fixed.

ui_bugs.issue: Third column header was labeled 'Email' but actually displays email_status ('sent' / 'email_error'). Fixed to 'Statut / Status'.

action_items: None — feature works as specified. Optional: consider seeding an activated affiliate in the test DB so the 'Already active' skip path can be automatically exercised (currently the pytest for it auto-skips if no active affiliate exists).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 10,801 lines — should be split into modules (routers/services). Not blocking, but flagged for maintainability.

Bulk invite endpoint correctly generates unique code, retries up to 6 times on collision, preserves existing code on re-invite, uses regex-based email validation, and returns partial-success shape {ok,total,sent,skipped[],failed[],results[]} — matches spec.
Email is lowercased server-side (row.email.lower().strip()) so responses may not match caller casing — documented via test assertion.
AdminAffiliates.jsx BulkInviteModal handles dropzone, CSV with/without header, preview count, and result display correctly.
test_credentials: admin@fironova.com / [REDACTED]; AdminGate: any value (ADMIN_GATE_CODE not set)
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_bulk_*, TEST_dup_*, TEST_reinv_*, TEST_ok_*, TEST_fe_a/b@example.com affiliates in DB during tests (marked with TEST_ prefix for cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_bulk_invite.py — run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_bulk_invite.py -v`. For FE, use init script to set localStorage['fironova_age_confirmed']='1' BEFORE navigation (key name matters — spec said 'fironova_age_ok' but actual key is 'fironova_age_confirmed', see /app/frontend/src/components/AgeGate.jsx). Login testids: login-email, login-password, login-submit. Bulk testids: affiliate-bulk-open, affiliate-bulk-modal, affiliate-bulk-file-input, affiliate-bulk-submit, affiliate-bulk-result, affiliate-bulk-download.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional bug found. Only a minor cosmetic label bug fixed in AdminAffiliates.jsx (results table third column header).
